heading: Organized youth, working toward a greener Benin.
body:
Bio-Gaz-Benin-Afrique SARL was founded on a simple conviction: the waste we throw away every day is really lost energy and lost fertility. Through the Green Dynamic Climate Emergency Program (PDEV-UC), our team designs biodigesters suited to the tropical climate, trains farmers, and turns organic residue into the Agri-Shell biofertilizer.

We work directly with family farms, religious institutions, schools, and government delegations and technical partners who visit our demonstration sites.

timeline.title: Diagnosis & design
timeline.text: Site, livestock, and energy/fertilizer needs assessment.

timeline.title: Biodigester construction
timeline.text: Excavation, dome masonry, sealing, and gas line connection.

timeline.title: Training & follow-up
timeline.text: Certifying farmers on biogas use and the Agri-Shell biofertilizer.

timeline.title: Scientific monitoring
timeline.text: Lab analysis of soil and inputs to refine our formulas.
